comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Η τροπολογία 8 αποσύρθηκε από την ομάδα ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Ændringsforslag 8 var blevet trukket tilbage af ECR-Gruppen.	</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
A alteração 8 foi retirada pelo Grupo ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Skupina ECR vzala zpět pozměňovací návrh 8.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
ECR komiteja bija atsaukusi grozījumu Nr. 8.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Amendment 8 had been withdrawn by the ECR Group.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
La enmienda 8 ha sido retirada por el Grupo ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Klub zastupnika ECR-a povukao je amandman 8.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Rinne an Grúpa ECR leasú 8 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Skupina ECR je umaknila predlog spremembe 8.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L'emendamento 8 è stato ritirato dal gruppo ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L'amendement 8 a été retiré par le groupe ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Amendamentul 8 a fost retras de către Grupul ECR.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
